info.title: API.SH: TheFork
info.description: The TheFork API from API.SH: public TheFork data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One restaurant on TheFork: name, cuisine, description, chef, address with coordinates, average price and currency, TheFork rating, review count and reviews in the last month, TripAdvisor rating and count, best offer, opening hours by day, payment methods, parking and transport, tags, awards, the a la carte menu by section with prices, set menus, PDF menus, photos and diners' photos, FAQ, the 20 latest reviews, and the full record in `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thefork-restaurant

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A TheFork restaurant id, e.g. 56948 (the number after -r in its url).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: the restaurant page url, e.g. https://www.thefork.com/restaurant/borgo-paris-r56948.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A restaurant's latest 40 reviews on TheFork (rating out of 10, meal date, text, reviewer name, review count and member-since date, restaurant reply, photos, likes), with the rating summary: overall rating and count, food, service and ambience averages, and the number of reviews per language.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thefork-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: the restaurant page url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Restaurants on TheFork (Europe and beyond) in a city or around a point, 25 a page, with the site's filters and sorts: id, name, url, cuisine, address with coordinates, TheFork rating and review count, average price and currency, price level, bookability, deals (offers and loyalty points), distinctions, tags (cuisine, setting, dishes, dietary, neighborhood...), payment methods, photos, today's time slots with their offers, and review snippets. Also the total count, the available filter groups with each option's id and count (pass ids as `tags`), and the sorts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thefork-search

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A TheFork city as in thefork.com/restaurants/<city>, e.g. paris-c415144, barcelona-c41710.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of city: a thefork.com city listing page (a tag page such as /restaurants/paris-c415144/italian-t436 also works).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Instead of city: latitude of the point to search around.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag ids from `available_filters` (e.g. 436 Italian, 2102 one MICHELIN star); all must match.

parameters.name: sale_type
parameters.description: A menu type id from `available_filters` (e.g. 3 set menus).

parameters.name: offers_only
parameters.description: true: only restaurants with a special offer.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: asc or desc (default desc; price and distance asc).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
